Our Story

Two names Sri Lankan healthcare already trusts — building the next one, together.

ALTHIA brings SLIIT's academic rigour together with Hemas Hospitals' clinical expertise, inside one allied health institute. Every programme is built around real practice, real patients and real placements — so graduates are ready from day one, not just on paper.
